summary: Client only. The player's gameplay controls and mouse pointer. Holds are counted per resource: controls stay off while any resource disables them, and the pointer shows while any resource shows it. A stopping resource gives back what it held.

blockAction.summary: Turns off one game action, whichever key it is on. Key.bind still receives the key, so this lets your resource take over a key. Each resource has its own count, as with disable(): the action returns once all have released it, and a stopping resource releases its holds. If the key is down when blocked, the game still sees it released. Throws a TypeError for anything except an action name, of letters, digits and _, up to 64 characters.

params.action: The name in the game's player action map, such as 'jump', 'use', 'opponent_lock', 'attack_primary_mouse' or 'toggle_crouch'.

blockAction.exampleLua:
-- client: space no longer jumps, but your bind on it still fires
local Controls, Key = kcds.ui.Controls, kcds.ui.Key

Controls.blockAction("jump")
Key.bind("space", function() return kcds.core.Events.toServer("ring:bell") end)

unblockAction.summary: Releases one blockAction(action) hold. The action returns when no resource holds it. Throws a TypeError for anything except an action name.
unblockAction.exampleLua:
-- client: E does nothing for five seconds
local Controls = kcds.ui.Controls

Controls.blockAction("use")
setTimeout(function() return Controls.unblockAction("use") end, 5000)

disable.summary: Takes away the gameplay controls, adding one hold.
disable.exampleLua:
-- client
local Controls = kcds.ui.Controls

Controls.disable()
Controls.showCursor()
-- ... a menu is open ...
Controls.hideCursor()
Controls.enable()

enable.exampleLua:
-- client: three seconds without control
local Controls = kcds.ui.Controls

Controls.disable()
setTimeout(function() return Controls.enable() end, 3000)

isEnabled.summary: Whether the player has the gameplay controls.

showCursor.summary: Shows the mouse pointer, adding one hold.

cursorPosition.summary: Where the mouse pointer is while your resource shows it (showCursor): { x, y }, each from -1 to 1, left to right and bottom to top, the screen position Camera.rayFromScreen takes. Null while no resource of yours shows the pointer, and while it is outside the game's window.
cursorPosition.exampleLua:
-- client: what is under the pointer
local Controls, Camera = kcds.ui.Controls, kcds.ui.Camera
Controls.showCursor()
setInterval(function()
  local at = Controls.cursorPosition()
  if at then
    local ray = Camera.rayFromScreen({ x = at.x, y = at.y, range = 10 })
    print(ray and ray.target)
  end
end, 200)
